text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking past the gym...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ready, set! Trinity Pose!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Knees! Elbows! Shoulders! Knees!
Elbows!
Shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
KNEES! ELBOWS! SHOULDERS!
TRINITYYY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is striking a pose by bending
her knees,
elbows, and shoulders at
sharp right angles.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Phew, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! You should've said
hello
instead of just standing there like a
log.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well? What'd you think of my

Knees-Elbows-Shoulders Trinity Pose?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right? It took tons of practice to get the
angles
right all at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of busting it out during
the next
winning concert...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But something still feels missing, you
know? What
do you think I can do to
really make it pop?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While part if me wonders if she's serious
about
posing like that at a winning
concert, I still have
to give her an
answer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I thought I was giving it my all, but
I guess
that didn't come across...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, prepare to be blown away,
Trainer! I'm
gonna do this with my
enthusiasm cranked up to
the MAX!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: KNEEES! ELBOOOWS! SHOOOULDERS!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: TRINITYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... Wheeeze...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find out later that Gold Ship's
full-chested
bellowing reached every
corner of the academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You want me to hold that pose for as
long as I
can? But it's so hard!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then again, moving a crowd to tears
through
sheer tenacity is the mark of a
true entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right. Challenge accepted! You'd
better watch
every second of this
performance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Trinity Pooose!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Behold... Gooolshi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship manages to hold the pose for
thirty
whole minutes. Seeing that level of
determination
fills me with courage... At
least, I think it does.
